notes.title: Minor Update #2
notes.content:
Here's another update with just a few small changes:

-Added a high-score display, which shows your all-time highest score whenever you die, and lets you know when you surpass it

-You can no-longer collect energy when the center of your ship is colliding with a star (you can still collect orbs, but can't get any-more out of a star when in this state). This change prevents players from simply ramming through small stars, but still allows you to occasionally bump into them without preventing energy collection

-Added a short grace period before you can click to respawn. This prevents accidentally respawning instantly when you are clicking frantically.

That's all for this update, let me know if you think anything else needs changing or fixing.

notes.title: Minor Update #1
notes.content:
This is a small update with only two change:
- The game now starts in fullscreen mode (you can still switch to windowed with f11)
- You can now click to respawn after dying
